title: Airstrike hits maternity hospital in Mariupol
body:
On 9 March 2022, during the siege of Mariupol, an airstrike hit Maternity Hospital No. 3, a complex that served as both a children's hospital and a maternity ward. The strike was attributed to the Russian Air Force. Reported casualties included at least four killed, among them one stillbirth, and 16 to 17 injured, including women in labour. A pregnant woman, Irina Kalinina, who was photographed after the attack, died after her baby was stillborn.

Russian officials rejected responsibility. Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said the hospital had been taken over by the Azov Battalion and other radicals and that staff and patients had been told to leave. Defence Ministry spokesman Igor Konashenkov called the strike a "completely staged provocation". Several media outlets and fact-checkers rejected the Russian claims, and Twitter removed a Russian embassy post calling the attack fake.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky called the attack proof of genocide, while EU foreign policy chief Josep Borrell called it a "heinous war crime" and UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres called it horrific. A report published by the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe (OSCE) on 13 April 2022 found that the hospital was clearly identifiable and operational, that no effective warning had been given, and that the attack was deliberate and constituted a war crime.
